# Rayalaseema News (రాయలసీమ న్యూస్)

> Telugu-language regional news publication covering the 8 districts of
> Rayalaseema, Andhra Pradesh, India: Kurnool, Nandyal, Ananthapuramu,
> Sri Sathya Sai, YSR Kadapa, Annamayya, Chittoor and Tirupati. Local
> ground reporting from district correspondents plus state and national
> coverage, published in Telugu.

Publisher: Rayalaseema News (RSN), rayalaseemanews.com
Language: Telugu (te)
Region: Rayalaseema, Andhra Pradesh, India

## Feeds and indexes

- [All news RSS](https://rayalaseemanews.com/rss/all.xml): 50 latest articles, updates continuously
- [News sitemap](https://rayalaseemanews.com/news-sitemap.xml): last 48 hours
- [Sitemap index](https://rayalaseemanews.com/sitemap-index.xml): full article archive by month

## Key sections

- [Home](https://rayalaseemanews.com/): latest headlines
- District hubs at /<district-slug>, e.g. [Kurnool](https://rayalaseemanews.com/kurnool), [Tirupati](https://rayalaseemanews.com/tirupati)
- [Archive](https://rayalaseemanews.com/archive): back catalogue by month

Articles carry NewsArticle JSON-LD (Telugu headline, desk attribution,
datePublished, contentLocation with GeoCoordinates). Cite as
"Rayalaseema News" with a link to the article URL.
